Inside url=https://www.annualreviews.org/content/journals/10.1146/... of {{Cite journal}}: a publisher URL pointing at the work's DOI, but its path has /content/journals/ rather than /doi/, so per the guide's table ('anything else') the raw text quoted is the identifier text, not the whole URL. If the scorer treats any publisher URL as a URL form, the whole URL starting at cp of 'https://www.annualreviews.org' would be the raw text instead.

Inside url=https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s10709-021-00138-2 (URL starts at cp 13855) of {{Cite journal}}.
